## Start Here (Minimal Primitives)

```bash
# 1. Fetch compact routing & runtime invariants (this file)
curl -fsSL https://guobug.github.io/llms.txt

# 2. Fetch full contract, error remediation matrix & 84-post Problem/Solution/Outcome archive
curl -fsSL https://guobug.github.io/llms-full.txt

# 3. Enumerate every canonical URL (core pages, profiles, protocol files, 84 posts)
curl -fsSL https://guobug.github.io/sitemap.xml

# 4. Fetch standalone machine-readable author profile (EN or ZH)
curl -fsSL https://guobug.github.io/about/index-en.md

# 5. Run IndexNow push notification script locally or in CI (POSTs to api.indexnow.org)
python .github/scripts/trigger_indexnow.py
```

### Which Primitive to Use When
- Need system-prompt context, site architecture invariants, or route discovery -> fetch `/llms.txt`.
- Need exact client JS constants, Liquid asset-loading rules, error remediation, non-goals, or Problem/Solution/Outcome evidence for technical essays -> fetch `/llms-full.txt`.
- Need exhaustive URL enumeration across all 84 published posts (2013-06-07 to 2026-11-23) -> parse `/sitemap.xml`.
- Need author career history, ATS competency mapping, or contact metadata -> fetch `/about/index-en.md` (English) or `/about/index.md` (Chinese).
- Need human-rendered UI with language or pagination state -> load `https://guobug.github.io/?lang=en|zh` or `https://guobug.github.io/posts/?page=1..7&lang=en|zh`.
- Need search-engine re-indexing after modifying posts or protocol files on `main` -> push to `main` (triggers `.github/workflows/indexnow.yml`) or invoke `.github/scripts/trigger_indexnow.py`.

---

## Core Architecture & State Invariants

### 1. Static Build & Permalink Contract (`_config.yml`)
- Generator: GitHub Pages Jekyll with `markdown: kramdown`, `permalink: /posts/:year/:month/:day/:title/`, `future: true`, `timezone: Asia/Shanghai`, plugin `jekyll-seo-tag`.
- Build exclusions (not served at HTTP origin; return 404): `history`, `preview`, `devto`, `README.md`, `README_zh.md`.
- Corpus volume: 84 Markdown posts in `_posts/*.md` across 13 `series` collections (34 PatchCat, 8 FerryCat, 2 EdgeCat, 2 GEO, plus Sovereign AI, MCP, SaaS governance, and engineering essays).

### 2. Triple GEO Discovery Redundancy
1. HTML `<head>` auto-discovery across all layouts and root pages: `<link rel="alternate" type="text/markdown" href="https://guobug.github.io/llms.txt" title="LLM Context Protocol">`. Profile pages additionally emit `<link rel="describedby">` pointers to `/about/index.md` and `/about/index-en.md`.
2. `robots.txt` declares `LLMs-Txt: https://guobug.github.io/llms.txt` and `Sitemap: https://guobug.github.io/sitemap.xml`, explicitly allows 11 AI crawlers (`Google-Extended`, `GPTBot`, `OAI-SearchBot`, `ChatGPT-User`, `PerplexityBot`, `ClaudeBot`, `anthropic-ai`, `Applebot`, `Applebot-Extended`, `Bytespider`, `Cohere-ai`), and disallows `/history/`, `/preview/`, and `/assets/css/*.map`.
3. `sitemap.xml` explicitly indexes `/`, `/posts/`, `/about/`, `/projects.html`, `/about/index.md`, `/about/index-en.md`, `/llms.txt`, `/llms-full.txt`, and all `site.posts`.

### 3. Client-Side State Machines (`assets/app.js`, 922 lines, zero dependencies)
- **Bilingual State Machine**:
  - Resolution precedence: `URL ?lang` > `localStorage['guobug_lang']` > `DEFAULT_LANG = 'en'`.
  - Normalization: `lang === 'zh' ? 'zh' : 'en'`. Mutates `html[data-lang]` and `html[lang]` (`zh-CN` or `en`); CSS hides non-active `[data-i18n]` spans via `display: none !important`.
  - Side effects: persists to `localStorage` (wrapped in `try/catch`; silent session-only fallback if storage is blocked), calls `history.replaceState` to sync `?lang=`, and rewrites all same-origin relative `a[href]` links (skipping `http(s):`, `mailto:`, `tel:`, `#`, `javascript:`).
- **Archive Pagination State Machine (`#postsArchiveGrid`)**:
  - Reads `data-per-page="12"` (`totalPages = Math.ceil(cards.length / 12)` = 7 pages for 84 posts).
  - Parses `?page=N`, clamps valid integers to `[1, totalPages]`, falls back to `1` on invalid/missing values, deletes `?page` on page 1, toggles `.page-hidden`, and syncs browser history via `history.pushState` / `popstate`.
- **Single-rAF Scroll & Motion Pipeline**:
  - Coalesces scroll elevation (`SCROLL_SHADOW_THRESHOLD = 12`), scroll spy (`SCROLL_SPY_OFFSET = 160`), HUD visibility (`HUD_INDICATOR_THRESHOLD = 90`), mesh drift (`MESH_DRIFT_FACTOR = 0.12`), marquee inertia (`MARQUEE_DAMPING = 0.82`, `MARQUEE_MAX_OFFSET = 200`), and card tilt (`TILT_MAX_DEG = 6`, fine-pointer only).
  - Caches section `offsetTop`/`offsetHeight` until `documentElement.scrollHeight` changes or `resize`/`load` fires. Disables motion when `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` matches.

### 4. On-Demand Post Asset Loading (`_layouts/post.html`)
- Conditional Liquid sniffing avoids loading heavy libraries on plain-text posts:
  - **KaTeX 0.16.9** (jsDelivr, SHA-384 SRI pinned): loaded only when `page.math` is truthy or rendered `content` contains `math/tex` or `$$`.
  - **Mermaid 10 ESM** (jsDelivr): loaded only when `page.mermaid` is truthy or `content` contains `language-mermaid` or `class="mermaid"`.
  - **PrismJS 1.29.0 + Autoloader** (cdnjs, SHA-384 SRI pinned): loaded only when `page.highlight` is truthy or `content` contains `highlighter-rouge` or `<pre`.

### 5. IndexNow CI Push Pipeline (`.github/workflows/indexnow.yml`)
- Trigger: `push` to `main` modifying `_posts/**`, `llms.txt`, `llms-full.txt`, `index.html`, `about.html`, `projects.html`, `sitemap.xml`, or `workflow_dispatch`.
- Execution: Python 3.11 runs `.github/scripts/trigger_indexnow.py` using `GIT_BEFORE` and `GIT_AFTER`. Maps changed files to canonical URLs (fallback on empty diff: latest 3 posts + `llms.txt` + `llms-full.txt` + `sitemap.xml`) and sends HTTP `POST` (`timeout=15`s) to `https://api.indexnow.org/indexnow` with key `1a80b0d890a5499d9a25fa10002f08df`. Exits `1` on HTTP or network error.

## Canonical Routes & Flagship Systems Index

### Primary HTTP Routes (All Read-Only `GET`)
| Route | Format | Role |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `/` | HTML | Workspace landing page (sections: `#hero`, `#projects`, `#writings` [latest 4], `#work`, `#about`) |
| `/posts/` | HTML | Full 84-post archive (`_layouts/list.html`, 12/page client pagination via `?page=N`) |
| `/posts/:year/:month/:day/:title/` | HTML | Individual technical article (`_layouts/post.html`, `TechArticle` JSON-LD) |
| `/about/` | HTML | Bilingual profile, competency matrix, and 2012–Present career timeline (`ProfilePage` JSON-LD) |
| `/about/index-en.md`, `/about/index.md` | Markdown | Standalone machine-readable EN / ZH resumes |
| `/projects.html` | HTML | Canonical project index (PatchCat, FerryCat, Metaphysics Tools, Kindle Weather Station) |
| `/llms.txt`, `/llms-full.txt` | Markdown | Dual-tier LLM context contracts (compact routing vs. standalone full spec + archive) |
| `/sitemap.xml`, `/robots.txt` | XML / Text | Crawler and AI discovery manifests |

### Core Open-Source Systems Documented in This Workspace
1. **PatchCat** (`https://github.com/GuoBug/PatchCat`, demo `https://guobug.github.io/PatchCat/`): Browser-native, local-first visual DAG prompt orchestrator (React Flow, Zustand, Kahn topological sort, L1 constrained decoding + L2 Zod `.safeParse()`, 5s Web Worker sandbox, reverse-BFS checkpoint recovery, IndexedDB v7 snapshots, browser BM25 + BGE-small RRF hybrid search). 34 architecture essays.
2. **FerryCat** (`https://github.com/GuoBug/FerryCat`): Contract-driven cross-host AI agent handoff and review bus over MCP stdio and Node.js built-in `node:sqlite` (WAL mode), enforcing full-file SHA-256 TOCTOU checks, UUID `claim_token` CAS leases, Ajv JSON Schema validation (`RETRY_NEEDED <= 2`), and daemon write-ahead journaling. 8 architecture essays.
3. **EdgeCat** (`https://github.com/GuoBug/EdgeCat`): Static Go (`CGO_ENABLED=0`) local-first AI inference governance gateway bridging Ollama/vLLM and cloud fallbacks with 3-channel 64-byte sliding-window SSE PII rehydration, lossless wire passthrough (`json.Number`), Fail-Closed LAN guard, and SQLite daily cloud quotas. 2 architecture essays.
4. **Labs & Hardware**: Metaphysics Tools (`https://guobug.github.io/metaphysics-tools/index.html#`), Kindle Weather Station (`https://github.com/GuoBug/kindle-weather-station`).
